desc: Ask [C16]: What did Arjun and I decide about retrieval?

body.question: What did Arjun and I decide about retrieval?

response:
{"id":19,"answer":"From your notes (meeting note with Arjun):

- Retrieval approach decided: lexical plus graph retrieval.
- Embeddings are deferred to v2 — so semantic/embedding-based retrieval isn't in the first version.
- Arjun will own the structure review.

Relevant context from your notes: the project itself (the DBMS for personal notes) was pitched as supporting semantic retrieval rather than just keyword search, so the lexical + graph decision is effectively a v1 scoping call that pushes the semantic/embedding part to a later version.

This is all from your saved notes; no general knowledge was needed.
